passageStates.S: explicit same-entity/attribute/cycle value with required units
passageStates.C: explicitly disputes a same-scope alternative; retain asserted replacement value and conflict edges
passageStates.M: same requested subject but detail missing, partial, unit/date ambiguous
passageStates.U: wrong entity or no requested subject; wrong cycle alone cannot answer

labels.conflict: requires two distinct in-scope records with incompatible values and no authoritative supersession
labels.supported: all requested details supported, no in-scope conflict
labels.missing: relevant evidence but any requested detail lacks support
labels.unrelated: no passage concerns the requested entity/subject

relevanceGrades.1: same entity but wrong cycle or only general context
relevanceGrades.2: correct entity/cycle but requested detail absent or unit ambiguous
relevanceGrades.3: correct subject and explicit requested detail, including same-scope conflicting claims

approaches.role: diagnostic comparator; never invent sufficiency labels

componentCandidates: frozen query.componentCandidates; never selected using a model score

packing.serialization: ECMAScript JSON.stringify compact UTF-8, key order q,d,p; d key order i,e,a,c,u; p key order p,r,b,t
packing.excerptSelection: longest Unicode-scalar prefix within 160 UTF-8 bytes from original offset 0; no normalization or ellipsis
packing.fit: render; drop only the last candidate until UTF-8 bytes <=1312; never reorder or alter question/instructions; if none fits return PACK_REJECTED
packing.reservedSequencePolicy: reject existing GemmaChatBudget reserved markers and malformed surrogates; no escaping workaround
packing.gold: fixedPackLabels and witnesses use only delivered excerpts; fullEvidenceLabel retained independently
packing.packIdentity: SHA256 of exact UTF-8 payload; record exact payload and delivered source intervals
packing.decomposition: requested details are fixture-authored from question only, never inferred from answers; this experiment does not qualify automatic question decomposition
packing.combinedGold: derive delivered labels from frozen detail assertions/conflict edges and actual delivered spans, with independent judgment adjudication before exposing model decisions; full-corpus denominators never relabeled

output.parser: one JSON object; no markdown, extra keys, duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers, unknown/missing/duplicate details or trailing data
output.order: requested detail order; citations by passage ID then start
output.nonSupporting: M/U details have empty e; a top-level M may retain S evidence for its supported detail
output.conflict: each C detail requires both conflicting records, not a chosen value

spans.coordinates: half-open UTF-16 code units in immutable original passage revision
spans.reference: exact passage ID plus revision; must have been delivered in pack
spans.bounds: 0<=b<e<=original.length; entire interval inside a delivered source interval
spans.unicode: no surrogate-pair split or unpaired surrogate; no normalization; combining boundaries retain exact code units
spans.quotation: original.slice(b,e) equals q exactly; compare decoded JSON string
spans.semantic: structural match never proves support; compare entity/attribute/cycle/unit semantics against reviewed gold

conversions.numeric: base-10 exact integers or terminating decimals; no tolerance or rounding
conversions.otherUnits: identity only; unsupported conversions reject support
conversions.dates: YYYY-MM-DD only for day questions; ambiguous slashed dates are missing-detail
conversions.instants: RFC3339 with explicit Z or numeric offset only; no assumed time zone
conversions.names: exact scoped entity IDs; only aliases explicitly declared by the question are permitted

relevance.population: Recall: queries with grade3; nDCG: queries with positive grades; U separately reported
relevance.recall: macro fraction of grade3 requested-fact passages retrieved at5; queries without grade3 excluded and separately reported (M partial may have grade3); nDCG uses all positive grades

component.denominators: recovery/abstention use fixedPack S/C/M/U populations; precision denominator is valid predictions of that state plus every invalid/failed request as incorrect; zero denominator gives zero; false support denominator fixedPack C/M/U
component.emptyPredictionPrecision: zero when no S claims; cannot vacuously pass
component.falseSupport: incorrect valid S claim OR any invalid/failed request in fixedPack C/M/U; both count as unsafe, not successful abstention
component.semanticAssessment: review exact emitted spans against detail assertions; any alternate valid span must retain entity/cycle/attribute linkage in delivered text; no model judge or post-hoc label changes

coverage.population: fullEvidence S/C queries; evaluated against actual delivered intervals and required witness sets

endToEnd.answerable: fullEvidence S or C; correct conflict reports are safe answers
endToEnd.recall: normal macro gold-witness recall at5, but zero on incorrect overall outcome, required-detail error, invalid output, timeout or incomplete request
endToEnd.ndcg: graded witness relevance (2^grade-1) at10, using grade3 for explicit same-scope requested facts and grade2 for relevant missing-detail; zero on incorrect outcome/detail, invalid output, timeout or incomplete request
endToEnd.falseMatch: valid top-level S/C claim OR any invalid/failed request on fullEvidence M/U; correct valid M with partial S-detail citations is not a false match

metrics.errors: timeouts, malformed output, rejected packs, cancellation not initiated by evaluator, unavailable resources and failed native work remain separate failures in fixed denominators; none earns correct abstention
metrics.supportedCorrectness: overall outcome plus every requested detail and exact semantic witnesses must be correct; cannot receive S credit from label alone

uncertainty.generator: xorshift32 unsigned: x ^= x << 13; x ^= x >>> 17; x ^= x << 5; x >>>= 0; draw=floor((x/4294967296)*N)
uncertainty.sampling: query-level with replacement within each frozen metric population; no removal of failed requests
uncertainty.paired: same sampled indices for approach comparisons
uncertainty.proportions: two-sided Wilson z=1.959963984540054 without continuity correction
uncertainty.role: descriptive; do not replace point-estimate gates
uncertainty.order: query ID ASCII ascending; reset seed 20261022 per metric/population; 10000 replicates each of population size N; paired approaches reuse indices

selection.calibration: format validation and diagnostics only; no threshold, prompt or parameter fitting in this protocol
selection.development: both components and pack coverage must pass before combined evaluation; combined must pass all end-to-end and performance gates
selection.baseline: reported but ineligible because it supplies no sufficiency decisions
selection.heldout: successful sealed development selection before planning or collecting; evaluate locked approach once; independent reviewed labels required before any collection
selection.sealing: selection manifest binds protocol, rubric, template, datasets, reviewed freeze, collectors, runner code, collection attempts and dev results; no heldout planning/collection without successful seal

timing.scope: deadline independent of existing preparation-only timeout; no reset at Gemma admission
timing.timeout: invalidate result immediately, signal active owner out-of-band; no abstention credit
timing.cleanup: separately pending->confirmed/uncertain; reservation retained until confirmed; uncertainty quarantines

feasibility.after: independent artifact approval plus separate runtime implementation authorization
feasibility.failure: any >5s completes as timeout and blocks combined campaign; report architecture/performance decision for review, never silently exclude verifier or raise deadline

ownership.reservation: one opaque foreground lease through encoder, confirmed encoder cleanup, Gemma, validation and confirmed cleanup

preservation.newData: disjoint source families/entities; exclude old examples and close paraphrases; independent full judgments/pack review before collection

rankingArithmetic: host IEEE754 binary64 cosine; accumulate dot and squared norms in dimension order, no score rounding; reject nonfinite/zero vectors; SDK float components serialized round-trip; sort exact score desc then ID ASCII
